detail.requirements:
• 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
• 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
detail.main_tasks:
• Work directly with Healthcare & Life Sciences customers to uncover their needs, guide migrations to AWS, and design responsible AI-powered, agentic, and cloud-native solutions aligned with their long-term business goals.
• Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers and blogs, and running workshops both in Korean and English.
• Demonstrate a builder mindset by rapidly developing AI and agentic AI prototypes on AWS in customers' non-production environments, helping Healthcare & Life Sciences customers validate ideas and accelerate their path to production.
• Partner with Sales, Partners, Specialists, service teams, and other AWS teams to bring the right expertise to customers and accelerate their adoption of AWS services, and craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of our services for Government, NPO, EdTech, University, and Healthcare industry domains.
detail.intro: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Solutions Architect in Seoul, Korea, who is passionate about helping Healthcare & Life Sciences organizations use AI, agentic AI, and cloud technologies to improve patient outcomes, accelerate research, and transform operations. This role is for a curious, customer-obsessed technologist who can navigate ambiguity, challenge traditional thinking, and turn complex industry needs into practical paths forward. You will engage customers early in their transformation journeys and help them experiment, learn, and scale with AWS to create visible and measurable impact.
detail.benefits:
• Flexible working hours and support for balancing work and personal lives
• Mentorship and career-advancing resources for professional development
• Inclusive employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promoting inclusion
detail.preferred_points:
• Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
• Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
• Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
